title: SPI service descriptor (schema v3)
description: Fork-owned acceptance contract at .spi/service.yaml. Declares what a service's acceptance suite needs, symbolically: bindings from a closed source vocabulary resolved per run against the stack's facts envelope (spi info --json, apiVersion spi.osdu.dev/v1), Key Vault secret references (names, never values), required loads and entitlement groups, sibling dependencies, and a timeout. The resolver engine (.github/actions/acceptance-resolver) is the authority on enforcement; it additionally rejects reserved environment variable names (exact: AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID, AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE, and common process names such as PATH, HOME, LD_PRELOAD, MAVEN_OPTS; prefixes: ACTIONS_, GITHUB_, RUNNER_, SPI_STACK_) and any key outside this schema, exiting 2 with the offending key named.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Unknown versions are a hard failure; the vocabulary grows only by a template contract change.

archetype.description: Build/test archetype. Deliberately closed; new archetypes arrive by contract change.

path.description: Repository-relative working directory of the suite, e.g. the upstream <svc>-acceptance-test module.

mavenArguments.description: Individual Maven argv tokens. Consumers pass the decoded array directly to Maven and never evaluate it as a shell string.

bindings.description: Environment variables the suite reads, each bound to a symbol from the closed source vocabulary -- never to an environment value. Resolution precedence per variable: explicit process environment (verbatim) -> source resolution -> declared default. template sources render last.

keyVaultBindings.description: Environment variable to Key Vault secret NAME, resolved from the stack's vault at run time. Secret values never appear in the descriptor.

loads.description: Named data loads the environment must have seeded (checked against published load facts by the deploy gate).

groups.description: Entitlement groups the test caller must hold.

dependencies.description: Sibling services this suite calls; a pinned dependency blocks the deploy gate with a typed reason.

source.description: Closed source vocabulary. Facts: gateway (base_url), partition (primary partition name), openid (OIDC v2.0 issuer URL, published explicitly by the stack), tenant (azure.tenant_id), legalTag (primary partition's legal_tag). keyvault:<name> reads that secret from the stack's vault. static carries the declared value; template renders ${NAME} references to other (non-template, non-secret) bindings after everything else resolves; user must be supplied by the caller's environment. Anything else is a hard failure naming the key.

suffix.description: Appended to a fact-sourced value (gateway values have their trailing slash stripped first). Fact sources only.

value.description: Required for static and template sources; invalid elsewhere.

default.description: Fallback when the fact or caller environment does not supply an answer. Invalid for keyvault sources (a default secret would put a secret value in the repository) and for static/template.
